_README: Stock solutions whose composition AND addition volume were recovered by reading a
primary source, for flattened cocktails MediaDive cannot serve (#150).
TRACKED, unlike the other cocktail caches, because it is curated research with
citations rather than a regenerable diagnostic. Losing it would mean re-reading the
This is NOT the rejected shortcut. PR #251 established that reusing a stock's usual
volume does not hold: the well-sampled stocks vary, the invariant-looking ones are
under-sampled. Every volume here is printed in the cited source and was read per
citing medium, not generalised from a population.
An entry is usable by apply_cocktail_nesting only if a record's flagged ingredients
match its `stock_components` on NAME and VALUE — the same test used for
MediaDive-sourced stocks, so a wrong stock cannot be applied on the strength of this
`applies_to_media` (optional): the source medium numbers whose OWN sheet was read
and found to state this volume. When present, a record is nested only if its
medium is on the list — a stock's volume is a property of the citing medium, not
of the stock, and MediaDive shows this one used at four different volumes across
the corpus. Records citing an unverified medium are left alone.

stocks.snippet: Medium 503 (ANAEROBIC FRESHWATER (FWM) MEDIUM) lists 'Seven vitamins solution 1.00 ml'; medium 194 states 'Supplement medium with 1.00 ml/l seven vitamins solution (see medium 503)'; medium 504 reproduces the stock as 'Seven vitamins solution (from medium 503) Vitamin B12 100.00 mg ...' in 1000 ml.

volume_verified_per_medium.194: Supplement medium with 1.00 ml/l seven vitamins solution (see medium 503)

stocks.notes: All 40 media citing this stock among the blocked records were fetched; 26 state the volume in their own sheet and every one of them says 1.00 ml — none contradicted it. The other 14 are lettered variants (298b-i, 503b/c, 829a) whose PDFs 404 or omit the line, so they are excluded via applies_to_media rather than assumed. MediaDive observes this stock at four different volumes corpus-wide, which is why per-medium verification gates it.
